genotype.statement: Homozygous NM_001282860.2:c.5517+1G>A confirmed separately in both siblings by Sanger; protein consequence remains unknown.
limitations: Coding identity and zygosity verified; source uses GRCh37/hg19 analysis, so packet hg38 genomic coordinates are not independently sequence-normalized.
NMD and loss of function are predictions; no patient RNA measurement, splice product or allele-specific functional assay.

segregation.statement: Both parents are heterozygous; affected sister and brother each homozygous in four separate chromatograms.

phase.statement: Homozygosity with heterozygous parents supports one inherited copy from each parent; no compound-heterozygote phase ambiguity.

causal_confidence.statement: Recessive segregation across two families, compatible neurodevelopmental phenotype and gene-level cellular/animal evidence support a GON4L association.
limitations: Only three examined individuals in two families; similar cousin unexamined and ungenotyped.

Historical prior same-splice family also carried homozygous Asp1522Gly; not an unconfounded additional family in this paper.
Healthy heterozygotes do not settle monoallelic penetrance; pLI is not proof of dominant pathogenicity.

Patient2upslanting narrative/caption contradicts downslanting rows in both tables; packet upper-lip eversion is not established. SupplementTableS1facial-asymmetry sum3 conflicts with two plus signs and mainTable1sum2/3.

MainTable1extremity-negative forPatient3coexists with joint laxity/pesplanus/incompletecreases. Situs-related heart position is distinguished from structural disease inFamily2; their heart structure is normal.

Family2AOHprintedChr1:52,281,228–171,076,768 spans118.8Mb, not printed18.8Mb. Main long-isoformNM_012812858.2 and MethodsVI1versus pedigreeIV1 are internal identifiers/typographical discrepancies, not silently corrected primary data.

SupplementS14caption says pink=long/blue=short but blue ENST00000368331.5 is called a long isoform in the same caption; its NM_001262860.2 also differs from main NM_001282860.2.
